import sqlite3

def fetch_record(database_path, table_name, column_name, value):
    conn = sqlite3.connect(database_path)
    cursor = conn.cursor()
    
    query = f"SELECT * FROM {table_name} WHERE {column_name} = ?"
    cursor.execute(query, (value,))
    
    record = cursor.fetchone()
    
    cursor.close()
    conn.close()
    
    return record
